summary: AI Product Engineer who owns AI features end to end — product and architecture through to shipped, monitored production systems. I've built AI in healthcare: an AI pediatric health app (video/sound-based health checks and a triage chatbot) and a clinical decision-support agent with retrieval, prompt and output-guardrail design, evaluation and monitoring. Strong Python/TypeScript/Node.js, LangChain/LangGraph, PostgreSQL and AWS, with a product mindset and high ownership.

Owned the product/engineering loop from prototype to release: AI feature design, model/API integration, and the workflows parents use.
Built an LLM-powered clinical decision-support agent that retrieves patient history to generate medication recommendations and AI-assisted diagnostic guidance.
Designed the retrieval, prompt, and output-guardrail layers for a production medical chatbot, evaluating output and improving reliability in a regulated domain.
Owned the full AI feature lifecycle: architecture, retrieval and prompt design, output validation, evaluation, deployment, and monitoring.
Built an AI-driven wellness platform with LangChain and RAG pipelines, normalizing third-party health data to generate personalized plans.
Developed an AI Virtual Trainer agent with agentic reasoning and personalization, increasing user engagement by **40%**; owned design, development, and deployment.
Built SmartMedHx, an AI-assisted patient-intake system applying LLM extraction to automate clinical workflows.
Built a platform from zero to **$1M+ revenue**, owning backend infrastructure, data models, and scalable APIs across **3,200+ brands** and **190+ countries**.
Delivered features end to end with remote stakeholders; improved backend performance by **25%**.
